_note: Voice sample palette. Every sample is a REAL card sentence from the pack that voice serves, spoken by the exact model and length_scale the game uses. Paired voices (same 'pair' key) speak the SAME sentence so the base/DLC difference is audible. Render with build_voice_palette.py; page is ../voices.html.

voices.name: American English
voices.role_note: Ships with FlashBoss. Speaks every English pack.
voices.text: She has filled the glass bottle with fresh cold water. If you eat a good breakfast, you will feel better all morning.

voices.name: British English (F)
voices.role_note: Voice DLC. Replaces the American voice in every English pack.
voices.text: She has filled the glass bottle with fresh cold water. If you eat a good breakfast, you will feel better all morning.
voices.gloss: The same two cards, so you can hear the difference.

voices.name: Deutsch
voices.role_note: Speaks German Core and both German extensions.
voices.text: Ihre Gesundheit ist das Wichtigste im Leben, passen Sie bitte immer gut auf sich auf!
voices.gloss: Your health is the most important thing in life, please always take good care of yourself!

voices.name: Esperanto (F)
voices.region: no country — a native Esperanto voice
voices.role_note: Trained for FlashBoss. Also speaks Toki Pona.
voices.credit: FlashBoss (CC0 1.0, trained on Mozilla Common Voice)
voices.text: La prezo de tiu libro estas tre malalta, do mi aĉetos ĝin.
voices.gloss: The price of that book is very low, so I will buy it.

voices.name: Español
voices.text: Logró superar todos los obstáculos gracias a su perseverancia y esfuerzo.
voices.gloss: She managed to overcome all obstacles thanks to her perseverance and effort.

voices.name: Castellano
voices.role_note: Voice DLC. European Spanish across every Spanish pack.
voices.text: Logró superar todos los obstáculos gracias a su perseverancia y esfuerzo.
voices.gloss: The same sentence — listen for gracias and perseverancia.

voices.name: Français
voices.role_note: Speaks French Core and both Pareto courses.
voices.text: Il y a des marchés partout dans le pays, et le sel et le poivre sont sur la table.
voices.gloss: There are markets everywhere in the country, and the salt and pepper are on the table.

voices.name: Italiano
voices.role_note: Speaks Italian Core and both Pareto courses.
voices.text: Ogni mattina faccio colazione con mia madre in cucina.
voices.gloss: Every morning I have breakfast with my mother in the kitchen.

voices.name: Latina
voices.role_note: Trained for FlashBoss. Restored classical pronunciation.
voices.text: Prima luce hostium equitatus ad castra accedit.
voices.gloss: At first light the enemy's cavalry approaches the camp. (adapted from Caesar)

voices.name: Ελληνικά
voices.text: Θα μένουμε σε ένα μικρό ξενοδοχείο κοντά στην πλατεία.
voices.gloss: We will be staying at a small hotel near the square.

voices.name: toki pona
voices.role_note: The free pack. Toki Pona's sounds are all in Esperanto.
voices.text: tenpo kama la, mi wile kama sona e toki pona.
voices.gloss: In the future, I want to learn Toki Pona.
